bonusly_new_achievement_trigger.description: Runs for each new achievement in Bonusly. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

bonusly_new_bonus_trigger.description: Runs for each new bonus in Bonusly. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

bonusly_new_redemption_trigger.description: Runs for each new fulfilled redemption in Bonusly. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

bonusly_new_user_trigger.description: Runs for each new user in Bonusly. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
